name: Compressors
description: Replacement options matched to unit make and capacity.
long_description: The compressor is the heart of every AC: it pressurises refrigerant and drives the cooling cycle. We help match rotary, reciprocating and scroll compressors to your unit's capacity, refrigerant and electrical supply so the replacement runs reliably.

parts.name: Rotary compressors
parts.detail: For split and window ACs, typically up to about 2 TR.
parts.summary: Fixed-speed hermetic rotary compressors are the standard in split and window ACs. They are compact, quiet and efficient at small capacities. We match the replacement to your AC's refrigerant, capacity, mounting and electrical supply.
specs: R22, R410A or R32 (must match the system)
PSC motor with external run capacitor
Suction accumulator mounted on the shell
Mineral oil for R22; POE or PVE for R410A and R32
GMCC, Highly, LG, Panasonic and others
notes: Replace like for like: same refrigerant, capacity and electrical supply
Fit a new run capacitor and filter drier, then vacuum and recharge by weight
Find out why the old compressor failed before fitting the new one

parts.name: Reciprocating compressors
parts.detail: For older and some commercial units.
parts.summary: Hermetic reciprocating compressors use a piston and valves to compress refrigerant. They are simple and serviceable, and are still found in older ACs, water coolers and light commercial refrigeration.
specs: R22, R134a or R404A (must match the system)
220–240 V, 1-phase, 50 Hz; 380–415 V, 3-phase on larger models
Run capacitor, or start capacitor and relay on hard-starting models
Mineral or alkylbenzene for R22; POE for R134a and R404A
notes: Match refrigerant, capacity, voltage and evaporating temperature range (AC or refrigeration duty)
Replace the start components and filter drier with the compressor

parts.name: Scroll compressors
parts.detail: For higher-tonnage ductable, package and commercial systems.
parts.summary: Scroll compressors use two interleaved spirals to compress refrigerant smoothly, with few moving parts. They are used in ductable, package and VRF outdoor units, rooftop units and chillers. See the Copeland and Danfoss model lists for exact models.
specs: About 24,000–485,000 BTU/h (2–40 TR) across the ranges we supply
R22 / R407C (Copeland ZR, Danfoss SM); R410A (Copeland ZP, Danfoss SH)
Mineral oil (R22 models); POE (R407C and R410A models)
Four-foot base with grommets; suitable for tandem sets on some models
notes: Three-phase scrolls run backwards if two phases are swapped: check rotation at start-up
Model number shows nominal capacity in thousands of BTU/h (e.g. ZR81 ≈ 81,000 BTU/h)

parts.name: Inverter (BLDC) compressors
parts.detail: Variable-speed compressors for inverter split ACs.
parts.summary: Inverter compressors use a brushless DC motor whose speed varies with the cooling load, cutting power use. They are driven by the outdoor unit's inverter board, so the replacement must match the original compressor and its drive.
specs: R410A or R32 (must match the system)
Three-phase variable-frequency output from the inverter PCB
POE or PVE, as specified by the maker
GMCC, Highly, LG, Panasonic and others
notes: Identify the replacement from the model code on the original compressor label
Motor characteristics must suit the inverter drive, or the board will show a fault
Check the inverter PCB and IPM before condemning the compressor

signs: Outdoor unit hums but does not start
Breaker trips when the AC switches on
Fan runs but air stays warm
